question: Who has to approve a $1,500 expense claim?
queries: Who has to approve a $1,500 expense claim?
expense claim approval chain manager Finance

results.title: Expense Policy
results.heading: Approval chain
results.text: Claims up to $1,000 are approved by the employee's manager. Claims above $1,000 also need approval from Finance.

results.title: Expense Policy
results.heading: Submission deadline
results.text: Expense claims must be submitted in the finance portal within 30 days of the expense.

results.title: Expense Policy
results.heading: Contractor expenses
results.text: Contractors may claim travel costs only when pre-approved in writing by their manager. No other expenses are reimbursable for contractors.

results.title: Travel Policy
results.heading: Approval
results.text: All business travel needs manager approval at least 14 days before departure, except for client emergencies.

results.title: Expense Policy
results.heading: Limits
results.text: Client meals may cost up to $120 per person. A director must approve any client meal over $500 in total.
